Feature: Doctor Appointment Management

  Scenario Outline: Doctor views pending appointments
    Given there are <count> pending appointments for the doctor
    And the doctor is <login_state>
    When the doctor views the appointments list
    Then the system displays <expected_result>

    Examples:
      | count | login_state | expected_result |
      | 1     | logged in   | a list with 1 item |
      | 0     | logged in   | an empty list |
      | 1     | not logged in | an error message |

  Scenario: Doctor provides consultation and prescription is generated
    Given there is a pending appointment for the doctor
    When the doctor provides consultation for the appointment
    Then a prescription is generated

  Scenario: Doctor prescribes lab tests during consultation
    Given the doctor is providing consultation for an appointment
    And the prescription is empty
    When the doctor prescribes a lab test named "Blood Test"
    Then the lab test is added to the prescription
